description: This file defines a React component named BookOverview that displays detailed information about a specific book, fetched from an API endpoint, and includes navigation features to go back to the previous page.

classes.name: BookOverview
classes.description: Main React component class that renders a detailed view of a book based on route parameters.

methods.name: handleClickToGoBack
methods.description: Handles navigation back to the previous page.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches book data after component mounts.

methods.name: getBook
methods.description: Fetches book details from the API based on route parameter id.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns JSX to render the book overview page.
